description: Dams is a dataset listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by United States Army Corp of Engineers (USACE). The Dams dataset is a representation of the National Inventory of Dams (NID), maintained and published by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, in cooperation with the Association of State Dam Safety Officials, the states, territories, and federal agencies. It is also part of the U.S. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of United States Army Corp of Engineers (USACE). Its keywords are inlandWaters, USA, National, NTAD, National Transportation Atlas Database, Transportation, Atlas, Database. The bounding box given is -176.6873,0.0000,144.7061,71.2667. The hub shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, not copyrighted, unrestricted public use (as stated on the hub). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
